work.title: Approved Design 004 canonical-run presentation
authority: Direct user instruction to implement approved Design 004 source-first under apps/workbench/public/design-004/.
Project Redwood invariant: unreconciled differences must be surfaced and never silently forced to balance.

intent.productGoal: Provide the approved evidence-first healthcare QoR Design 004 as an isolated Workbench presentation of a canonical persisted run.
intent.capability: Serve Design 004 at /design-004/index.html, bind its financial and evidence state solely through GET /api/runs/:id, retain Workbench/Review/Decision lenses, selected A/R contextual evidence, seven workflow hand-offs, and responsive behavior.
architecturalIntent: The approved prototype DOM, CSS, interaction model, typography, and information architecture are the starting source architecture.
The canonical Workbench run API remains the only financial and evidence authority; the presentation performs no financial calculation and sends no writes.
The Design 004 directory is a parallel static surface and does not replace the root Workbench, /next, server, or API implementation.
invariants: Unreconciled A/R and all blocked/open governance status remain visible; no presentation path plugs, offsets, or conceals a residual.
Observed evidence, derived arithmetic, professional judgment, decisions, disposition, and release authority remain distinct.
If canonical data is unavailable, the page explicitly reports that state rather than supplying local fallback financial data.
acceptanceEvidence: Static syntax, typecheck, build, and conformance-schema validation.
Browser runtime screenshots at exact 320px and 390px CSS viewports for Workbench, Review, Decision, and evidence drawer; desktop Decision capture.
Release authorization matrix implemented as a current G7 plus verified approved active release record with an exact dependency fingerprint and passed-G7 snapshot.
Diff review demonstrating excluded root, server, build, and persisted-run surfaces remain unchanged.

decisions.decision: Copy the approved prototype source assets into the isolated public/design-004 directory and retain the exact base stylesheet.
decisions.rationale: This preserves source-first fidelity while making the presentation reversible and isolated.

decisions.decision: Replace only the prototype financial extract authority with an asynchronous GET /api/runs/:id adapter.
decisions.rationale: The canonical persisted run owns financial facts; missing, invalid, or failed run requests are shown explicitly rather than being replaced with embedded fixture data.

decisions.decision: Add a narrow 390px lens layout correction after observing clipped lens access in an initial mobile capture.
decisions.rationale: All three required professional perspectives must remain accessible on narrow screens without changing the design information architecture.

decisions.decision: Require release display to verify the active approved record against the exact canonical run, profile, version, dependency fingerprint, and its passed G7 snapshot.
decisions.rationale: A passed gate or merely present release record cannot independently authorize a current client release.

decisions.decision: Describe reconciliation/finding intersections as available shared-reference matches only.
decisions.rationale: Shared references are contextual evidence, not authoritative relationship, causation, disposition, or completed review.

decisions.decision: Replace narrow-viewport concealment with wrapping, grid sizing, and viewport-constrained drawers.
decisions.rationale: A responsive surface must keep controls readable and accessible rather than hide clipped content.

observedBehaviour: GET /api/runs/c8f21c7f-82a5-47a1-9d21-ab78af14660a returned the exact canonical run with four reconciliation controls, seven source records, one finding, and eight gates.

The selected A/R drawer visibly renders $4,539.31, explicit A/R snapshot versus GL A/R, unresolved arithmetic status, unset materiality, an available shared-reference match with its non-authoritative boundary, and contextual source references.
Review renders the A/R scrutiny question and preserves the distinction between the observed difference and absent professional judgment.
The 390px Decision capture shows the mobile workspace control, Workbench/Review/Decision lens access, exact unverified release authorization fallback, and stacked conclusion boundaries.
At 320px and 390px CSS viewports, Workbench, Review, and Decision show all three lens controls without clipping; evidence drawer stays within the viewport and wraps control detail.

Decision header and readiness card display the exact fallback Release authorization unverified. for the canonical run because its G7 gate is not passed and no verified current approved release record exists.
The selected A/R drawer labels the finding as an Available shared-reference match and explicitly disclaims authoritative relationship, causation, disposition, and completed review.

learning.recurringPattern: Approved visual source assets can remain faithful while a very small adapter substitutes canonical runtime authority for a design-only extract.
learning.improvementProposal: If Design 004 becomes a supported product route, explicitly register its directory entry and add browser interaction coverage for the seven presentation hand-offs without widening its API authority.
durableKnowledge: Design 004 is opened at /design-004/index.html and accepts ?run=<canonical-run-id>, plus the source-preserved view and evidence query parameters.
The static server serves nested public assets directly; this integration needs no backend routing change.
